18177789175431137.title: Witherslack, Cartmel and Dragon the cockerel
18177789175431137.place: Moss Howe Farm, Witherslack, Lake District
18177789175431137.notes:
Dragon lives at the Royal Oak in Cartmel, where we popped in after L'Enclume. Annette and Ceri made friends with him and some of the other fancy birds.
Ian had a new Seestar smart telescope delivered to the campsite, and we got a decent clear night at Moss Howe to try it out. Once the sun went down it came out on its tripod for a few captures of the Moon and the stars, including the Crescent Nebula in Cygnus.
Ian's more detailed astro pictures are on his astronomy site, https://uv101.uk, and the story of this first night is at https://uv101.uk/posts/2026-09-23-day-one.html
